'''Zombies''' can be found in the [[Lair of Tarn Razorlor (dungeon)|Lair of Tarn Razorlor]] or the [[Chaos Tunnels]].

If players wish to train on them in the Lair of Tarn Razorlor, the banker [[Odovacar]] can be found close to the entrance to the dungeon, allowing easy banking at a cost of 100 [[coins]] per use. A [[toad batta]] item spawn can also be found nearby for additional healing.

Many zombie locations are far from banks. These locations are close to banks:
* The [[Tarn's Lair|lair of Tarn Razorlor]] has a banker, [[Odovacar]]. However, using this dungeon requires the completion of the [[Haunted Mine]] quest, the [[Lair of Tarn Razorlor (miniquest)|Lair of Tarn Razorlor]] miniquest, and a 100 coin fee each time accessing the bank.
* The zombie cave in the [[Chaos Tunnels]] is easily accessed from the entrance in level 4 [[Wilderness]] to tunnels and is thus moderately close to the [[Edgeville bank]]. However, care should be taken because the entrance is still in the Wilderness and enters the cave with rather dangerous [[gargoyle]]s. Aggressive [[Skeleton (Tarn's Lair)|skeleton]]s in the cave with the zombies may interfere with zombie hunting.
